currency_assumptions: Budget/scoring currency is USD; venue-local costs are recorded in CHF (cost_local_amount/cost_local_currency CHF).

USD-equivalent conversion basis for every converted CHF amount: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rate dated 2026-08-13 (EUR 1 = USD 1.1534; EUR 1 = CHF 0.9373), fetched 2026-08-13 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml — derived 1 CHF = USD 1.230556 (USD per CHF = 1.1534 / 0.9373). Every venue rate_estimate_note records this dated basis. No FX rate is invented; where no dated conversion basis exists the USD equivalent stays null with a question.
decision_note: technical placeholder for pipeline integrity; Joe decides the date.
open_questions: Event window: 09:00-17:00 (8 hours), per the locked plan.
Calendar-awareness research coverage is 2026-09-15 through 2026-10-31 and is informational only; no calendar record is an elimination, tier input, or date recommendation.
target_date 2026-09-26 is a neutral technical placeholder required by score/bundle/summary integrity; it is never a recommendation and no output may present it as one.

Venue open question: most Geneva hotel and convention venues (Palexpo meeting rooms, Hotel N'vY, Warwick Geneva, Mövenpick Hotel & Casino, CICG, BFM) are inquiry-only with no published rates; written quotes are required before any cost claim above published-rate or estimated-from-rate status. Impact Hub Geneva and the Ville de Genève municipal Salle communale de Plainpalais publish rates on their own pages and are retained as scored candidates.

Impact Hub Geneva (ih-038) is a Tier-1 trusted resolver match and publishes Grand Salon/Petit Salon rates on its own spaces page; its stated reception hours are Monday-Friday 9h-19h, so Saturday event availability and full-day booking terms are unconfirmed and remain verification questions.

Community-research open question: no PyData Geneva chapter exists (the nearest PyData group is PyData Lausanne, ~60 km away); the Genève R User Group Meetup page returned 'Group not found' at fetch time; no standing Geneva quant community page with observed activity was found in this pass; Crypto Valley (Zug) and Swiss AI (swissai.ch, primarily German-speaking Switzerland) are adjacent ecosystem context, not Geneva-local community records — verify whether newer Geneva web3/quant groups should be added.

FX conversion basis gap: the ECB 2026-08-13 reference rate is used for all USD equivalents in this package; it is a dated published basis but is not a live market rate and does not predict the 2026 Q4 rate. Re-confirm the conversion basis at booking time.

recommendation.rationale: Run A evidence package only. Venue selection deferred: a later deterministic pipeline card scores venues and assembles the venue-phase bundle; Joe selects from eligible/shortlist_ready results. No date recommendation is made.
